name: Lammwirt
beschreibung: The Lammwirt is located in a tranquil village in Tirol, nestled in an alpine setting. The surroundings are ideal for nature lovers and offer hiking opportunities in summer and ski areas in winter. The amenities of the hotel include comfortable rooms, a restaurant serving traditional Tiroler cuisine, and a sauna area. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with a focus on coziness. The target group consists of vacationers seeking a relaxing stay in nature, as well as active vacationers. The hotel combines traditional elements with modern comfort.
